answers.core: Since this is a _built-in_ property for the **base** Node class, it would only make sense to have this feature be something out of the box as opposed to something the user would have to install.
answers.workaround: This _could_ be accomplished through script, however it is not really convenient to keep track of. Although the manual implementation could utilize a combination of signal and timers to achieve the same effect, managing this manually would require a lot more effort and clutter (especially with managing multiple nodes with different rates) rather than a builtin property that can be managed directly. This implementation also allows for inheriting the parent's `process_rate` -- similar to `process_mode` -- for even _easier_ organization.

title: Add a Node property to specify a reduced processing rate
